## Safety and evidence checklist

- [ ] Device-specific and shared interfaces remain aligned
- [ ] Units, component identifiers, BLE characteristics, and limits were checked
- [ ] Medical, clinical, patent, and regulatory claims cite authoritative
  evidence
- [ ] No patient data, credentials, keys, private filings, or generated output
  was added
- [ ] Documentation was updated for changed interfaces, intended use, or claims
